primitiveBudget: 7 generated polygon chambers, one generated body rib, six transient gates
commitThreshold: one continuous sweep crossing two distinct gates, then one chamber knot committed
memoryRule: the crossing stays exact; release knots three remote chambers as unseal, fold, and seal roles; four knots persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch drags through two distinct gates; ArrowRight arms the deterministic crossing and Enter commits; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: paired hinge paths, compound contour, and aperture mass -> seven filled polygon chambers making one faceted SVG body
compositionRupture: sparse diagonal register, heavy slab, and singular contour -> dense off-axis body with a dark internal seam and six skin gates
encounterRupture: three-click route, absence selection, and delayed answer -> one continuous crossing through two gates followed by release
temporalRupture: route verdict, remote aperture, and winding memory -> transient crossing followed by a discrete chamber knot with four retained events
mediumRupture: paired SVG paths and compound even-odd paths -> generated SVG polygons, generated rib path, and produced chamber cuts
changedRule: A single continuous crossing is geometry-neutral. Only release after two distinct gates knots three unvisited chamber polygons, while the crossed gates stay exact.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a seven-chamber faceted body, not a path register. A valid crossing changes remote polygon size, position, notch, and rotation; four knots remain visible and liftable.
falsifier: Delete if a gate changes geometry before release, if a repeated gate commits, if only colour or readout changes, if crossed chambers answer themselves, if the blind field reads as a panel diagram, or if later knots reset.
deletionCondition: Delete v042 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the chamber body from v039-v041 or if the remote polygon changes are not materially visible.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
